tool_a:
- tool_a — the CPIC lookup row for the gene(s) and drug(s) named in the query.
  The row holds: phenotype, recommendation, strength of recommendation,
  implications, comments.
tool_b: - tool_b — no source; answers from the model's own knowledge. No lookup, no retrieval.
tool_c:
- tool_c — the CPIC lookup row, plus the most relevant passages retrieved
  from the CPIC guideline and supplement PDFs.
